title: Ocean floor cross-section sheet
subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y4 lesson 14 (Ocean floor cross-section sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 14: Under the waves: the ocean floor. To understand the main features of the ocean floor

parts.label: Step 5
parts.text: A ridge up, then a deep trench

questions.q: Is the continental shelf deep or shallow?
questions.model: The shelf is at the edge of the land. It is the drowned edge of the continent. So the water is shallow.

questions.q: Which ocean is the Mariana Trench in?
How much deeper is Challenger Deep than Everest is tall (roughly)?
Draw and label an ocean floor cross-section: coast, continental shelf, slope, abyssal plain, ridge, trench, with depths.
questions.a: All six parts labelled in a sensible order with approximate depths
questions.model: Teacher draws the coast and the shelf first.

questions.q: Write three sentences describing a dive from the coast to the trench.
questions.a: For example: First the water is shallow over the shelf. Then the slope drops. The trench is the deepest part.

questions.q: Why is it so hard to explore trenches?
questions.a: They are dark, cold and the water pressure is enormous

questions.q: A long underwater mountain chain is a:
Big question: could Everest fit in the deepest trench?
questions.a: Yes: Challenger Deep is about 10,900 m deep, deeper than Everest's 8,849 m
